verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs directly state that it is 'typically among the first providers to deploy a newly released model' and that it makes it simple to run 'the latest machine learning models,' which addresses the story head-on. This is a vendor marketing claim only, with no stated timelines, release examples or SLA. missing for 10: concrete examples or turnaround times for new open-weight releases, independent or hands-on corroboration of day-one availability
